responsibility: Collects common x86 target configuration for GNU userspace ELF environments shared across 32-bit and 64-bit variants. It sets default ABI policy such as pcc-style aggregate return on 32-bit, TLS direct segment references, common CPP/CC1 specs, math-related endfile additions, exec-stack note handling, stack-check policy, and conditional split-stack support, serving as the shared GNU-userspace OS layer beneath gnu-user.h and gnu-user64.h.
